signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Welcome back. Sign in to your Bondo account.
signIn.rememberMe: Remember my email address on this device

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.subtitle: One account for orders, wishlists and faster checkout.
signUp.terms: I agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: We'll email you a link to choose a new one.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way.
forgotPassword.sentHint: The link is valid for one hour and can be used once. Check your spam folder if it does not arrive.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Pick something you have not used here before.
resetPassword.linkExpired: This link is no longer valid.
resetPassword.linkExpiredHint: Reset links expire after an hour and can be used only once. Ask for a new one and it will work.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.subtitle: One click and your account is ready.
verifyEmail.body: We sent a confirmation link to your inbox. Open it to finish setting up your account. The link expires in 24 hours.
verifyEmail.resent: Sent. Give it a minute to arrive.
verifyEmail.sent: Account created. Check your inbox for the confirmation link.
verifyEmail.expired: That link has expired. Request a new one below.
verifyEmail.invalid: That link could not be read. Request a new one below.
verifyEmail.verifiedBody: Everything is ready. Welcome to Bondo.

errors.emailInvalid: That does not look like an email address.
errors.passwordTooWeak: Mix in upper and lower case, a number or a symbol — at least three of the four.
errors.passwordsDoNotMatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.termsRequired: Please accept the terms to continue.
errors.phoneInvalid: That does not look like a phone number.
errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password do not match an account.
errors.emailTaken: There is already an account with that address.
errors.emailNotVerified: Confirm your email address before signing in.
errors.linkExpired: That link is no longer valid.
errors.samePassword: Choose a password you have not used here before.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.currentPasswordWrong: That is not your current password.
errors.resetSessionMissing: This reset link has expired. Ask for a new one and try again.
errors.profileUpdateFailed: We could not save your profile. Try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
